name: player_filter_camera_probe_blocking_hits
description: Player::FilterCameraProbeBlockingHits filters camera probe hit batches in place by clearing nodes that should not obstruct camera placement.
known_limits: Binary Ninja disassembly/HLIL for 0x406730 validates fastcall ECX=batches, EDX=batchCount, early return for non-positive batch counts, batch stride 0x504, candidate node slot offset 0x24 with entry stride 0x28, clearing entry.node for node flag 0x08000000, clearing callback-context kind 2 when flag 0x00100000 and context are present, and clearing parsed checkpoint nodes only while g_HudSensorTracker.raceCheckpointMode is active.

The native smoke verifies retained normal hits, cleared ignored-flag hits, cleared player-context hits, cleared active checkpoint hits, retained non-player callback-context hits, second-batch traversal, and non-positive batch no-op behavior.
No VC object-byte manifest covers 0x406730 yet, so tier S verification is deferred to a coherent Player camera/source-cluster pass.
